description: This file contains classes and functions for managing screenshots and thumbnails within the Superset project, including cache handling, image resizing, and WebDriver interactions for charts and dashboards.

classes.name: StatusValues
classes.description: Enumeration of possible cache payload statuses: Pending, Computing, Updated, Error.

classes.name: ScreenshotCachePayloadType
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of cache payloads, including image, timestamp, and status.

classes.name: ScreenshotCachePayload
classes.description: Class representing the cache payload for screenshots, with methods for serialization, status updates, and cache TTL checks.

classes.name: BaseScreenshot
classes.description: Base class for handling screenshot generation, caching, and resizing for charts and dashboards.

classes.name: ChartScreenshot
classes.description: Subclass of BaseScreenshot for chart-specific screenshots, modifies URL for standalone mode.

classes.name: DashboardScreenshot
classes.description: Subclass of BaseScreenshot for dashboard-specific screenshots, modifies URL for standalone mode.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates a ScreenshotCachePayload instance from a dictionary.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Serializes the cache payload to a dictionary.

methods.name: update_timestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp to the current time.

methods.name: pending
methods.description: Sets the cache payload status to pending.

methods.name: computing
methods.description: Sets the cache payload status to computing.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cache payload with a new image and sets status to updated.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets the cache payload status to error.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Returns the image as a BytesIO stream, raises exception if no image.

methods.name: get_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the cache payload.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Returns the current status as a string.

methods.name: is_error_cache_ttl_expired
methods.description: Checks if the error cache TTL has expired.

methods.name: is_computing_stale
methods.description: Checks if a computing status is stale, indicating a stuck or failed task.

methods.name: should_trigger_task
methods.description: Determines if a new task should be triggered based on cache status and TTL.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Returns a WebDriver instance based on feature flags and availability.

methods.name: get_screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot using the WebDriver.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on URL, size, and other parameters.

methods.name: get_from_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache payload from cache storage.

methods.name: get_from_cache_key
methods.description: Retrieves a cache payload from cache storage using a cache key.

methods.name: compute_and_cache
methods.description: Computes the screenshot or thumbnail and caches the result, handling errors and resizing.

methods.name: resize_image
methods.description: Resizes an image byte stream to specified thumbnail size, with optional cropping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for ChartScreenshot and DashboardScreenshot, modifies URL for standalone mode.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key for dashboard screenshots, including permalink key.
